ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $OB$ is the bisector of $\angle AOC$, and $OD$ is the bisector of $\angle COE$. If $\angle AOB=50^\circ$ and $\angle DOE=35^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since OB is the bisector of $\angle AOC$, and OD is the bisector of $\angle COE$, \\
therefore $\angle COD = \angle DOE = 35^\circ$, $\angle COB = \angle BOA = 50^\circ$. \\
Thus, $\angle BOD = \angle COD + \angle COB = \boxed{85^\circ}$.
